title: calliandra centralis
intro: Calliandra centralis, commonly known as the Powderpuff tree, is a flowering plant native to Central and South America. The health benefits of Calliandra centralis include its potential to stimulate wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a treatment for gastrointestinal issues, fever reduction, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Calliandra centralis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
